## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Is your request related to a particular
workflow or frustration? <!-- e.g. "I'm always frustrated when..." -->

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

## Additional Context

Anything else that helps explain the request — target SDKs/languages, related
OpenFeature or OFREP spec proposals, Kubernetes-specific considerations (CRDs,
operators, GitOps workflows), or examples from other feature flag tools.
